_: Alice Cooper's Nightmare Castle on the Spooky P-ROC rig (PAD-954): Helshaks' WIP 1.0.2
(VPUniverse file 30571), a scripted table on a photo of the machine's playfield. Written by
gen_alice_map.py, which says how each object was matched.
platform: spooky puts PAD.Controller on tools/proc_emu's board (prochw.py --bridge, spkbridge.py):
switches are the board's numbers, coils and LEDs their places in config/alice.yaml.
title: ac

table.name: Alice Cooper's Nightmare Castle (Spooky Pinball 2017) WIP

cabinet._: the cabinet's switches (config/alice.yaml): 1000 + the switch number; the coin door's ENTER, UP, DOWN and EXIT. The machine launches with its button (autoFire), no shooter rod: the plunger key is that button

plunger._: autoFire launches with the table's own plunger, made a solenoid launcher (PAD-960: pulled back 150 ms and let go, it kicked the ball a little way up the lane and no more)

trough._: trough1 (by the eject) to trough4, the jam opto last; 4 balls (numBalls)

saucers._: kicker -> the switch it holds and how the coil kicks it out (dir, power), as the table's own Kicker2.Kick 50, 5

flippers._: the tribute flips inline in its key handlers; these are those bodies

solenoids._: coil [0, n] (n: its place in config/alice.yaml's PRCoils) -> the small number the table sees (core.vbs flippers 46/48, the upper right 34); callback a sub of the table's or the bridge's (null = nothing fires). Names are the yaml's.

extra_vbs:
'---- PAD: Alice Cooper's mechs follow the machine (gen_alice_map.py)
' the drop targets: the game's reset and knockdown coils (the table reset
' them at its own drain)
Sub PadDrop(t, sw, down)
	t.IsDropped = down
	Controller.Switch(sw) = CBool(down)
	If down Then
		PlaySoundAt "fx_droptarget", t
	Else
		PlaySoundAt "fx_resetdrop", t
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadDT1Up(e) : If e Then PadDrop sw3, 1037, 0 : End If : End Sub
Sub PadDT2Up(e) : If e Then PadDrop sw2, 1036, 0 : End If : End Sub
Sub PadDT3Up(e) : If e Then PadDrop sw1, 1022, 0 : End If : End Sub
Sub PadDT1Down(e) : If e Then PadDrop sw3, 1037, 1 : End If : End Sub
Sub PadDT2Down(e) : If e Then PadDrop sw2, 1036, 1 : End If : End Sub
Sub PadDT3Down(e) : If e Then PadDrop sw1, 1022, 1 : End If : End Sub

' the flippers: the table flipped inline in its key handlers; these are
' those bodies, on the machine's coils
Sub PadLFlip(e)
	If e Then
		LeftFlipper.RotateToEnd : PlaySound "fx_flipperup", 0, .67, -0.05, 0.05
	Else
		LeftFlipper.RotateToStart : PlaySound "fx_flipperdown", 0, 1, -0.05, 0.05
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadRFlip(e)
	If e Then
		RightFlipper.RotateToEnd : PlaySound "fx_flipperup", 0, .67, 0.05, 0.05
	Else
		RightFlipper.RotateToStart : PlaySound "fx_flipperdown", 0, 1, 0.05, 0.05
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadURFlip(e)
	If e Then
		RightFlipper1.RotateToEnd
	Else
		RightFlipper1.RotateToStart
	End If
End Sub

lamps._: table light -> the game's LED [n // 64, n % 64] (n: its place in config/alice.yaml's PRLEDs; rgb: one LED, lit in its colour). The table's lights sit on the photo's inserts.
